about: The collecta of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who on this day didst reveal Thine only-begotten Son to the nations by the guidance of a star, mercifully grant that we who now know Thee by faith may be led even unto the contemplation of the beauty of Thy majesty. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
